headlines.title: What General Motors Holders Got Right
headlines.summary: If you only glanced at GM headlines this year, the privacy settlement over OnStar data or a pause at an Indiana battery plant probably grabbed your attention more than the quieter progress in earnings and capital returns. Holding General Motors over the past year would have returned 20.3%, including dividends. If you were deciding on 28 October 2025 whether to buy, what would you have needed to believe about Ultium, software, and capital allocation for that outcome to feel reasonable?

headlines.title: Law firm that handled Lehman, Enron bankruptcies plans to wind down
headlines.summary: Leaders at Weil, Gotshal & Manges, the nearly century-old law firm that worked for companies from the Lehman Brothers to General Motors, recommended on Wednesday that the firm shut down.

headlines.title: Dear GM Stock Fans, Mark Your Calendars for November 17
headlines.summary: General Motors stock rallies as automaker announces plans of moving listing from NYSE to Nasdaq. Tigress Financials sees massive upside in GM shares.

headlines.title: General Motors Is Up 16% in a Year, and Mary Barra Says It’s “Undervalued”: Buy More?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Motors stock is up 16% in the past year, but all of that gain came before 2026, and the stock is down 1% this year since GM stopped raising its profit outlook. CEO Mary Barra says the stock is undervalued, and GM’s buyback record supports her.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Stock May Be 39% Undervalued Despite $20b Buyback
headlines.summary: General Motors has climbed sharply over the past few years, and with investors now focused on its cash generation and heavy use of buybacks, the live question is whether the current share price fairly reflects the cash flows behind it. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned about 194.3%, which puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying cash flows can support that kind of re-rating.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
